connector.name: Agentmarketplace MCP
connector.registryDescription: Discover MCP servers + tools, auto-install into any client, pay for x402 endpoints in USDC.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agentmarketplace-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the stevemilton account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ARISPAY_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. ArisPay API key (ap_live_… or an agent-scoped key from `agentmarketplace agent create`). Required only for publish_agent and paid call_agent invocations.

env.name: AGENTMARKETPLACE_URL
env.description: Override the registry URL. Default: https://api.arispay.app/v1/marketplace
